messages:
Maria P.: FYI AuroraMarket reached out — they want a Q3 reseller promo with guaranteed capacity. Asking for ~48k GPU hours over a 6-week promo window across eu-west + us-east. Can we move fast on a provisioning plan?
Jamal R.: 48k over 6 weeks = ~8k GPU-hrs/week. What's our baseline committed to them vs what they'd like as soft-reserve?
Maria P.: They asked for "guaranteed" but are open to a blended approach: 60% hard reserve, 40% burst/soft. So target reserve = 29k GPU-hrs.
Alex L.: Quick back-of-envelope: 29k GPU-hrs across 2 regions over 6 weeks -> ~2.4k GPU-hrs/week/region assuming even split. If we serve on H100s that's X throughput. Do we have spare Dedicated pools for that?
Sophie K.: Current Dedicated spare capacity (eu-west + us-east) is ~1.6k GPU-hrs/week/region after internal buffers. We can free up another ~800 GPU-hrs/week/region by shifting low-priority batch to spot. But networking egress constraints in eu-west could be an issue for pre-warm replicas.
ops-bot: capacity-forecast: new alert — projected weekly GPU-hrs for AuroraMarket promo = 8,000 (6w window). Risk: region eu-west shortfall 32%.
Jamal R.: So shortfall looks like ~800 GPU-hrs/week/region -> ~9.6k GPU-hrs over 6 weeks. Options: 1) convert some soft-reserve to hard commit (higher $), 2) spin up short-lived burst nodes (spot/backfill), 3) ask Aurora to narrow window. Thoughts?
Maria P.: Aurora prefers predictable performance; they'd accept a small SLA credit instead of full hard commit if we provide a fallback model variant with lower perf but sufficient QoS. That helps reduce hard reserve.
Alex L.: Technically doable: allocate a small dedicated pool for the canary and routing policy that falls back to perf-tier-2 models during spikes. We need autoscale pre-warm policy: pre-warm one rack 12 hours before peak windows. Example config we can push to infra:
```
# prewarm policy (pseudo)
pool: aurora-q3-promo
regions: [eu-west-1, us-east-1]
min_dedicated: 8 gpus
prewarm_start: 12h
burst_policy: spot-backfill
fallback_model: gpt-7b-ll-lite
```
Sophie K.: Note: eu-west has a known transient networking flap under sustained high egress last month. Ops flagged limits: 10Gbps per-rack egress throttle kicks in around sustained 600MB/s. If the reseller workload is throughput-heavy (many concurrent short chats) we'll need to shard across racks.
Jamal R.: Can we price the blended commit? Proposed pricing: hard-commit at $3.75/GPU-hr for H100 equivalent, soft-burst at $5.00/GPU-hr when we tap reserved burst. That preserves margin and incentivizes smaller hard commit.
Maria P.: Aurora asked for a reseller SKUs mapping and a reporting cadence. We'll need per-SKU metering + daily consumption exports. Ops: can we add daily export feed to their partner S3?
Alex L.: Yes — add a delivery pipeline tag 'partner:aurora' and enable daily export to their S3 prefix with signed URLs. We'll throttle to 1 export/sec to avoid spiky writes.
Sophie K.: Action items:
- Alex: draft prewarm + fallback config and confirm rack-level egress sharding by EOD.
- Jamal: model the blended pricing and commit vs margin impact (show 3 scenarios: 30/70, 60/40, 100/0 hard commit).
- Maria: ask Aurora to confirm exact promo calendar (start/end) and expected peak hours (their local timezone).
- Ops-bot: run a 72h simulation using historical traffic profile and return expected tail-latency 95/99 with fallback route.

Alex L.: I'll also validate kernel selection for gpt-7b-ll-lite quantized path — should save ~25% GPU-hr vs full model and reduce egress by ~15% for chat-mode.
Jamal R.: If Aurora tightens to 40k GPU-hrs total, that solves shortfall without changing pricing much. Maria — can you push that ask?
Maria P.: Will do. I'll push a revised LOI this afternoon with two options (60/40 and 40k hard-commit) and note the fallback plan + reporting.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist posted: https://redwood.internal/ops/playbooks/aurora-q3-provisioning
Alex L.: One more note — tagging for billing needs to be in place before start date or we'll have to reconcile usage manually. I'll add a pre-start gating check in the playbook.
Sophie K.: Good. If anyone spots region quota hurdles during prewarm, ping #eng-infra and I'll escalate to cloud account. :rocket:
Maria P.: Thanks team — syncing w/Aurora at 3pm. I'll update thread after call.
